description: This file contains a test class 'MyReviewsAPITest' for the 'MyReviewAPI' class within the OrangeHRM performance plugin. It includes test methods that verify the API's endpoints, data provider functions for JSON test data, and uses PHPUnit conventions for testing the API's functionalities and validation rules.

classes.name: MyReviewsAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the 'MyReviewAPI' endpoints within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes data-driven tests and placeholders for API method validation.

methods.name: testExternalJsonExamples
methods.description: Tests API JSON examples loaded from external JSON files, ensuring the test cases are correctly formatted and accessible.

methods.name: dataProviderFromExternalJsonExamples
methods.description: Loads test cases from an external JSON file, providing data for the 'testExternalJsonExamples' method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' endpoint of the 'MyReviewAPI' class using test case parameters.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method, loading scenarios from a YAML file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the 'create' method of 'MyReviewAPI', expecting it to throw a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for creating a review, expecting a 'not implemented' exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the 'delete' method of 'MyReviewAPI' with expected 'not implemented' behavior.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests validation rules for delete operation, expecting 'not implemented'.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' endpoint method with expected 'not implemented' exception.
